# Introduction

This notebook retrieve gene information and functional annotation about of the Mouse genome. We choose to prioritize Ensembl identifier.


# Reference genome from GENCODE
```{bash,eval=FALSE}
curl -LO --output-dir data/ 'https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_mouse/release_M32/gencode.vM32.annotation.gtf.gz'
curl -LO --output-dir data/ 'https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_mouse/release_M32/GRCm39.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz'
```

# Reactome pathways
```{r,eval=FALSE}
curl -LO --output-dir data/ 'https://reactome.org/download/current/Ensembl2Reactome.txt'
curl -LO --output-dir data/ 'https://reactome.org/download/current/ReactomePathways.txt'
curl -LO --output-dir data/ 'https://reactome.org/download/current/ReactomePathwaysRelation.txt'
pigz data/*.txt
```

```{bash,eval=FALSE}

```

library(biomaRt)

# From Ensembl

## Retreive informations about genes from Ensembl using biomaRt package
```{r}
mart <- useEnsembl('genes','mmusculus_gene_ensembl')
gene_info <- getBM(
  mart = mart,
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","entrezgene_id","mgi_id","external_gene_name","gene_biotype","chromosome_name","start_position","end_position","strand")
)
gene_info$position_GRCm39 <- as.character(with(gene_info,GRanges(chromosome_name,IRanges(start_position,end_position),strand = strand)))
gene_info$strand <- gene_info$start_position <- gene_info$end_position <- NULL
gene_info <- as(gene_info,"DataFrame")
```


## GO terms

```{r}
gene_info$go_ids <- local({
  x <- getBM(
          mart = mart,
          attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","go_id")
        ) |>
        subset(go_id != "")
  x$ensembl_gene_id <- factor(x$ensembl_gene_id,unique(gene_info$ensembl_gene_id))
  x <- splitAsList(x$go_id,x$ensembl_gene_id)
  unique(x[gene_info$ensembl_gene_id])
})
```


```{r}
gene_info$goslim_goa_accession <- local({
  x <- getBM(
    mart = mart,
    attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","goslim_goa_accession")
  ) |>
  subset(goslim_goa_accession != "")
  x$ensembl_gene_id <- factor(x$ensembl_gene_id,unique(gene_info$ensembl_gene_id))
  x <- splitAsList(x$goslim_goa_accession,x$ensembl_gene_id)
  x[gene_info$ensembl_gene_id] |> unique() |> unname()
})
```



```{r}
gene_info$reactom_id <- local({
  x <- read.table(
    "data/Ensembl2Reactome.txt.gz",sep = "\t",comment="",header=FALSE,quote="",
    colClasses = c("character","character","NULL","NULL","character","character")
  )
  names(x) <- c("ensembl_id","reactome_id","evidence","organism")
  x <- x[x$organism %in% "Mus musculus",]
  x$ensembl_id <- factor(x$ensembl_id,unique(gene_info$ensembl_gene_id))
  x <- splitAsList(x$reactome_id,x$ensembl_id) |> unique()
  x[gene_info$ensembl_gene_id] |> unname()
})
```





```{r}
gene_info$iuphar_family <- local({
  x <- read.table("data/iuphar_targets_and_families.tsv",sep="\t",quote='"',comment="",skip = 1,header=TRUE,check.names = FALSE)

  # Check that family is a subgroup of type
  stopifnot(max(lengths(unique(splitAsList(x$Type,x$`Family name`))))==1)
  
  x$`Mouse Ensembl Gene` <- factor(x$`Mouse Ensembl Gene`,unique(gene_info$ensembl_gene_id))
  x$iuphar_family <- paste(x$Type,x$`Family name`,sep="///")
  iuphar_family <- splitAsList(x$iuphar_family,x$`Mouse Ensembl Gene`) |> unique()

  iuphar_family[gene_info$ensembl_gene_id] |> unname()
})
```

```{r}
gene_info$msigdb <- local({
  gmt <- unz(
    'data/msigdb_v2023.1.Mm_files_to_download_locally.zip',
    'msigdb_v2023.1.Mm_files_to_download_locally/msigdb_v2023.1.Mm_GMTs/msigdb.v2023.1.Mm.entrez.gmt'
  ) |> read_gmt()
  gmt <- setNames(gmt$MEMBERS,gmt$STANDARD_NAME) |> 
    stack("msigdb","entrezgene_id")
  gmt$entrezgene_id <- factor(gmt$entrezgene_id,unique(gene_info$entrezgene_id))
  gmt <- splitAsList(as.character(gmt$msigdb),gmt$entrezgene_id)
  c(CharacterList(character()),gmt)[match(gene_info$entrezgene_id,names(gmt),nomatch = 0)+1L] |> unname()
})
```



# Save annotations
```{r}
# binary version
saveRDS(gene_info,"data/gene_info.rds")

# text version
local({
  gene_info <- readRDS("data/gene_info.rds")
  msk <- sapply(gene_info,is,"CharacterList")
  gene_info[msk] <- gene_info[msk] |> lapply(unstrsplit,";")
  write.table(as(gene_info,"data.frame"),gzfile("data/gene_info.tsv.gz","w"),sep="\t",row.names = FALSE)
  closeAllConnections()
})
```
